column1: # The jars of HermiT 1.4.5.519, the release for OWL API 5, that classification needs:
# HermiT itself, dk.brics.automaton, Trove 3 and commons-logging. HermiT runs on the OWL API
# 5.1.20 jars of elk.tsv in place of the owlapi-distribution 5.1.9 its POM names, and its
# XML and command-line dependencies are left out. nix/reasoners/default.nix fetches each
# from Maven Central under this path and checks it against its SHA-256 here, which was
# checked against Maven Central's SHA-1 when it was pinned. HermiT is licensed under
# LGPL-3.0, and the jars are never committed.
